description: Update job hunt settings and search filters. Use this to change what jobs are matched. IMPORTANT: When updating config, you must pass the ENTIRE config object as it replaces the existing config (not a partial merge). Use get_job_hunt first to see current config, then include all fields you want to keep.

autoMode.description: Enable/disable full autopilot mode. When enabled, jobs are automatically matched, scored against your resume using AI, and applied to if they meet your minMatchScore threshold. Resume customization (if enabled) is applied before each application. Each auto-apply consumes a credit.

config.description: Search filters configuration. REPLACES entire config - include all fields you want to keep.

companySize.description: Company sizes (e.g., ["xs" for 1-50, "s" for 50-200, "m" for 200-1K, "l" for 1K-5K, "xl" for 5K+])

dateOffset.description: Only match jobs posted within this time window (e.g., "7D" for last 7 days). Default is "7D".

excludedKeywords.description: Keywords to exclude from job results

excludedTitles.description: Job titles to exclude from results

expLevels.description: Experience levels (e.g., ["SE" for Senior, "MI" for Mid-level, "EN" for Entry])

industries.description: Industries (use get_industries to see valid values)

locations.description: Locations to match. Use plain city names without state abbreviations (e.g., "San Francisco" not "San Francisco, CA"). For states, use the full state name (e.g., "Texas"). Use "Remote" to match remote jobs worldwide without country restrictions.

relevancy.description: Search relevancy mode - HIGH for strict title/skills matching, MEDIUM for broader keyword-based results. Default is null (MEDIUM behavior).

remote.description: When true, only return remote jobs. When false or omitted, return all jobs (both remote and non-remote).

workArrangement.description: Work arrangement filter (e.g., ["Full Time", "Part Time", "Contract", "Internship", "Freelance", "Temporary"]). Defaults to ["Full Time"] if not set.

customizeResume.description: Enable/disable AI resume customization for applications

dailyLimit.description: Maximum jobs to auto-apply per day (max: 100)

minMatchScore.description: Minimum match score for auto-apply (0-1). Default is 0.70 (70%) when not explicitly set.

name.description: New name for the job hunt

name: update_job_hunt
